why: Drops the one-pixel exemption, so every visually-hidden label reads as a menu scrolling sideways. `.ui-sr-only` (hud.css:4403) is `width: 1px; overflow: hidden` holding a whole sentence, reporting 1px over 55; measured, 68 of them across the sweep, every one a false positive. The exemption is keyed on the box rather than the class so any visually-hidden idiom is covered, and no box wider than a pixel is excluded by it.
killedBy: menu hit-target verdict (issue #686) passes the two reported shapes that are wider than their box and are not defects
menu hit-target verdict (issue #686) fails a one-pixel box only for being one pixel, not for the class it happens to carry
